x: North, O'Hara, Dabbs, Thorpe and Black were to be joined by Hugh Barrow for the "National" at Sheffield, leaving runners of the class of Steer, Reilly and Hart as reserves.
Gilson faded a little and soon had Major and Reilly closing on him. At halfway there was nothing to choose between ourselves, Mitcham and Herne Hill but the latter appeared to have a slender lead.
Because of this we attempted to do the same this year but finished one place further down in each event; both teams being affected by injuries and Thresher, Hart and Reilly all being unavailable.
With Gerry North, Thresher and Barrow not running (besides other possibles like Newell, Reilly, Dance and Kerr) this surely would have produced our fastest "Brighton" team.
Of last year's team, Dabbs, Hart, Bicourt, Thorpe, Black and Reilly were absent their places being taken by Buxton, Williams, Geoff North, Whewell, Major and Kerr.
